po_control.title: Purchase orders require an approved requisition
po_control.hint: When on, a purchase order is raised only from an approved, awarded requisition. A direct order needs the manual-order override and a written reason, kept on the order. Nobody approves an order they raised or asked for.

requisition_required.blocked: Your company requires purchase orders to come from an approved requisition. Raise a purchase request instead.
requisition_required.override: Your company requires an approved requisition. You may raise this order directly with the manual-order override; say why.
requisition_required.reason: Why this order cannot go through a requisition
